How it works

Built for the gaps in your week.

Side projects rarely die from bad ideas. They stall when restarting takes more energy than the time you have.

  1. Leave yourself a note

    Each project keeps where you left off, what’s blocking you, and a next step specific enough to start without thinking.

  2. Pick a step that fits

    Have 15, 30 or 60 minutes? SideQuest suggests an unblocked step that fits the time you actually have.

  3. Finish, then set up next time

    Mark the step done, write the next one while it’s fresh, and watch your weekly trail and milestones grow.

What’s inside

Everything you need to keep going. Nothing you don’t.

Questions

Good to know

Who is SideQuest for?

People building something on the side (a shop, a game, a newsletter, a portfolio) who have scattered pockets of time and lose momentum between sessions.

Is my data private?

Your projects are only visible to you. We don’t run ads or third-party tracking scripts, and payments are handled by Stripe; we never see your card number.

Can I take my data with me?

Yes. Download a complete JSON backup from inside the app at any time, and restore it into any SideQuest workspace.

What happens if I cancel Pro?

You keep Pro until the end of the period you paid for. After that, all projects stay; you can keep working on them and finish them, but you can’t add a fourth active one.

Can I get a refund?

Yes. Email us within 14 days of any charge, first payment or renewal, and we’ll refund it in full. See the terms for details.

Can I delete my account?

Yes, from the app footer. Deleting your account removes your workspace and cancels any subscription.
